craft.evidence: mock-shelf-light.png: strong 40px left edge, grouped gaps, rising strip. fragrance-dark.png: SAVE sits on the fold line at 40 percent grey, nearly clipped; mock-fragrance-light.png has labels in mixed ink on pastel and a dead lower-left; mock-add-fragrance-dark.png shows the chord twice (tall strip and bar) with the right half empty; monograms SMN, D3, TK are cryptic.

fixes.text: Pressed states on primary, secondary, destructive, text, icon and floating buttons are still filled grey slabs and component cards are boxed; use the 70 percent opacity press from direction.md section 6 and remove fills.
SAVE is greyed and sits on the fold line, effectively clipped; put the primary action in the toolbar's trailing edge above the fold at full ink.
Give the render a first read: drop chevrons on list rows and the FILTER and ADD FRAGRANCE rows as stacked blocks; set Add as a bold trailing word and rows as name plus a coloured chord.
Accord labels use white on pastel segments (aromatic, amber, sweet); pick label ink per segment by luminance so all seven read at the same contrast in both modes.
House monograms (SMN, D3, TK, IND) cannot be read; show the house name in full for the focused group and under each group where width allows.
Notes still draw as Top, Heart, Base rows with chevrons; render them as three coloured bands and drop the chevrons.
The chord appears twice (tall strip and bar); keep one and use the freed right half for the empty-shelf wording or the format choice.
A 170px empty band sits between the accord legend and the format bar; lift the format bar or add the sampler group label so the screen ends deliberately.
